verdict.rationale: The product lets users choose which MCP servers and skills to add from the Settings Library, which determines the external tools available to the agent. It also gates tool calls with approval prompts and a full-permissions toggle. However, there is no documented per-tool or per-integration allow/deny list and no lead- or team-level policy enforcement. Missing for 10: granular per-tool/integration allowlists or blocklists, admin- or team-level policy controls that individual users cannot override, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access

citations.quote: Add skills and MCP servers from the Library in Settings.
The composer's full-permissions toggle switches between asking and allowing every tool call.
Write commands ask once per session; destructive ones always ask.
